shared_tail.surface: عبد الله بن عمرو بن العاص

notes: The first route ends at ابن شهاب with «ح»; the second repeats ابن شهاب and then goes on, so the two routes meet at ابن شهاب and the text writes its teachers and the Companion once: shared tail (rule 3)
«قال سمعت عبد الله بن وهب» — Abu al-Tahir heard Ibn Wahb (rule 5)
«قال قلت فإني أطيق» is Ibn Amr's own speech inside the saying: not a link
